QUOTE: "One token, zero hits in read corpora, zero hits in corpora `search` does not read, file docs present | \"This IS a definitive empty result…\" | Strong, but only about the indexed scope" and "One token, but rows exist in an unread corpus (e.g. a typedef) | \"NOT DEFINITIVE — this index HOLDS matching rows… ask by name with dossier\""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives definitive-for-scope and not-definitive grades, but it never names a third grade for an empty reply that is definitive for a reason other than absence. The "NOT DEFINITIVE" rows are all about uncertainty, not a definitive-but-not-absent grade.
